scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @cura/shared build && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web "pnpm --filter @cura/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @cura/server dev" "pnpm --filter @cura/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @cura/shared build && pnpm --filter @cura/server build && pnpm --filter @cura/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @cura/shared build && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @cura/shared build && pnpm -r --if-present test --exclude test/automation-archive-performance.test.ts && pnpm --filter @cura/server exec vitest run test/automation-archive-performance.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 && node --test supabase/seed-browser-fixture.test.mjs scripts/release-from-ci.test.mjs scripts/summarize-cloud-check.test.mjs
